name: Video Maker
tagline: Gives your finished track two videos: a vertical lyric Short plus a longer cut.
description: Hand it a completed song and you get two visuals back: a vertical Short with the words timed to the music, plus a longer video that carries the whole track. Every step uses no-cost tools, so an independent or AI-music artist can give a release a real video without a production budget.
author: PaulHPowell13
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
